name: Chinshakiangosaurus
sum: Chinshakiangosaurus is a basal sauropod from the Early Jurassic of Yunnan, China, known from a fragmentary skeleton.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: A fragmentary skeleton; only the dentary and teeth have been studied in detail.
biology: Upchurch and colleagues (2007) read its tooth differences as hints about feeding habits.
author: Yeh 1975

sources.text: Upchurch, P. 2007. A re-evaluation of Chinshakiangosaurus chunghoensis Ye vide Dong 1992 (Dinosauria, Sauropodomorpha): implications for cranial evolution in basal sauropod dinosaurs. Geological Magazine 144(2): 247–262. doi:10.1017/S0016756806003062
Buffetaut, E. 2005. A new sauropod dinosaur with prosauropod-like teeth from the Middle Jurassic of Madagascar. Bulletin de la Société Géologique de France 176(5): 467–473.
